# Geekflare

> > Geekflare is a technology resource covering cybersecurity, development tools, hosting solutions, consumer tech, and gaming guides for developers, IT professionals, and tech enthusiasts.

Geekflare provides practical tutorials, product reviews, and technical guides across infrastructure, security, software development, and consumer technology. The site features in-depth coverage of Linux, Windows, DNS security, email security, cloud services, and emerging technologies like cryptocurrency and NFT gaming.

## Key Topics

- Cybersecurity & Email Security
- DNS & DNSSEC
- Linux System Administration
- Windows System Maintenance
- Driver Updates & PC Performance
- Apache HTTP Server
- Ubuntu & APT Package Management
- Crontab & Task Scheduling
- SPF Records & Email Spoofing
- Bitcoin Mining & Cryptocurrency
- Real-time Application Development
- Smart Home & Consumer Electronics
- Game Server Hosting
- Instagram Analytics
- Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)

## Cybersecurity & Infrastructure

- [How to Test & Fix Missing SPF Record Vulnerability/Email Spoofing?](https://geekflare.com/cybersecurity/fix-email-spoofing-missing-spf-record-vulnerability): Guide to testing and fixing SPF record vulnerabilities using MX Toolbox
- [How to Test DNS Security Risk & Fix to Avoid Being Hacked?](https://geekflare.com/cybersecurity/dns-security-test): Guide to testing DNS security, DNSSEC, and zone transfer vulnerabilities
- [Spear Phishing: What Is It and How to Detect and Mitigate It?](https://geekflare.com/cybersecurity/spear-phishing): Guide to detecting and mitigating spear phishing attacks and social engineering
- [Apache HTTP Installation Troubleshooting Guide](https://geekflare.com/cybersecurity/apache-installation-troubleshooting): Troubleshooting Apache 2.4 compilation errors and APR dependencies on CentOS

## Linux & Development

- [Crontab in Linux – with Real-time Examples and Tools](https://geekflare.com/dev/crontab-linux-with-real-time-examples-and-tools): Tutorial on Linux crontab commands and cron task scheduling with examples
- [What are Ubuntu Repositories? How It Works and How to Enable/Disable It](https://geekflare.com/dev/ubuntu-repositories-explained): Explanation of Ubuntu repositories, APT package manager, and DEB packages
- [9 Websites to Run Linux from Web Browser [Online Emulators]](https://geekflare.com/dev/run-linux-from-a-web-browser): List of online Linux emulators like JSLinux for browser-based testing

## Software & Application Development

- [11 Best Software to Build Real-time Applications](https://geekflare.com/software/build-real-time-apps): Comparison of real-time app platforms: Ably, Pusher, PubNub, ZEGOCLOUD
- [Guide to Different Types of ATS [Applicant Tracking Systems]](https://geekflare.com/guide/ats-types): Guide to ATS deployment models covering Oracle Taleo, iCIMS, Greenhouse
- [What Is Instagram Insights?](https://geekflare.com/guide/instagram-insights): Guide to Instagram Insights metrics and social media analytics tracking

## Windows System Maintenance

- [10 Best MAC Address Lookup Tools for Every Need](https://geekflare.com/consumer-tech/mac-address-lookup-tools): Review of MAC address lookup tools like Wireshark for vendor identification
